latest.notes: Patterns everywhere: the cut-out pattern on every part it fits, in Boxes, the Hinge Box, Letters, Parametric and the QR plate, plus your own seamless tile. Paper Box folds in 3D with a Fold slider, explode and mountain and valley creases, and has 14 new structures with 29 presets: pyramid, cube, prism, cone, bakery box, hinged lid, pie box, clamshell, takeout pail, carry box, wine carrier, paper bag, CD sleeve and cell inserts. Parametric wall art: wave, ridge, noise, ripple, mountain and attractor patterns as slat walls on 1x2 to 1x4 rails, with shelves, an organic edge, sheet and lumber estimates and GLB export.
